# Technical Stack (This Portfolio Site)
Technologies:
  - Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
  - Runtime: React 19
  - Language: TypeScript
  - Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, PostCSS
  - Internationalization: next-intl (ja / en / vi), localePrefix always
  - Animation: Framer Motion, GSAP
  - 3D/WebGL: OGL (Galaxy background)
  - UI Libraries: Lucide React, FontAwesome, Hamburger React
  - Gallery: PhotoSwipe
  - Contact: EmailJS (@emailjs/browser)
  - Analytics: Vercel Analytics
  - Fonts: Montserrat, Noto Sans JP (Google Fonts)
  - Design Pattern: Glassmorphism

# Site Architecture
- Locale-based routing via Next.js App Router: /[locale]/...
- Default locale: Japanese (ja)
- Static params generated for all locales at build time
- Galaxy WebGL background (fixed, full-screen, OGL-powered)
- Floating navbar (desktop) + Hamburger menu (mobile)
- Project data served from /public/projects.json
- Skills data served from /public/skills.json
- Awards data served from /public/awards.json
- Gallery metadata from /public/gallery-meta.json
